title: Yongle Bell (Dazhong Temple, Beijing)
status_note: Rung at New Year; moved three times.

place.label: Dazhong Temple Ancient Bell Museum, Beijing
place.coords_source: OpenStreetMap Nominatim lookup of the named site (ODbL)

mass_note: 46.5 t (english.beijing.gov.cn) vs about 46 t (Beijing Cultural Heritage Bureau)

timeline.event: Cast during the Yongle reign of the Ming dynasty

tiers.everyday: The Yongle Bell in Beijing was cast in the early 1400s and weighs about 46 tonnes. More than 230,000 Chinese and Sanskrit characters cover it.
tiers.student: Beijing's government page gives 46.5 t, 6.75 m high and 3.3 m across, cast under the Yongle Emperor (1403–1424), with more than 230,000 characters of Buddhist texts. The heritage bureau gives about 46 t and 5.5 m: the height conflict is kept open.
